On 24 July 2025, the Joint Standing Committee on Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Affairs (JSCATSIA) was appointed to inquire into and report on matters relating to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander affairs. Matters may be referred to it by either the House of Representatives, the Senate or a Minister. In addition, the committee may inquire into annual reports of government departments and authorities, and reports of the Australian National Audit Office that refer to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander affairs.

Committee membership comprises seven Members of the House of Representatives and four Senators.

Support Services

Material on this webpage can be confronting. Sometimes words can cause sadness or trigger traumatic memories. If you need to talk to someone, support is available. The following services are available 24 hours a day:

Beyond Blue: 1300 224 636
1800RESPECT: 1800 737 732
MensLine Australia: 1300 789 978
Lifeline: 13 11 14
Suicide Call Back Service: 1300 659 467
13YARN: 13 92 76
